narrativeFindings: Across JACC, Circulation, and European Heart Journal, ORA volume declined from 2008 to 2022 while journal impact factors rose sharply.
Mean ORA 2-year citations plateaued: JACC stayed near 28-29, Circulation rose modestly from 25 to 37, and EHJ rose then stabilized near 36.
The ORA share of 2-year citations fell from 72% to 46% in JACC, 66% to 43% in Circulation, and 69% to 38% in EHJ.
Guidelines, statements, and statistics had the strongest NORA citation expansion and increasingly shaped journal-level metrics.
Scopus is the primary citation source, iCite is the validation citation source, and WoS supports indexing and total-citation comparison.
